description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relations - Notify the Wages Board for the Baking Trade
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the approval and implementation of decisions made by the Wages Board for the Baking Trade under the Wages Boards Ordinance. It involves regulatory matters (setting minimum wage rates for different classes of workers) and constitutes a statutory instrument/notification under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
